order: Fix all four findings from the latest cross-vendor review round and record its verdict. Make the touches lint compare path elements one by one rather than joining them into a collision-prone comma string. Have the deep-plan glob matcher reproduce the retired regular expression's line-terminator classes exactly, so the replacement matches what its predecessor matched. Give the checkout module a startup sweep that reclaims abandoned worktrees whose directories are still on disk, since pruning alone clears only the registrations whose directory has already gone missing, and keep the checkouts this process is actively using exempt from that sweep. Correct the wording future review orders use, so an order enumerates every commit inside its pinned range instead of describing that range as a single commit. Record the review verdict verbatim in the roster, hold the tranche at REVISE pending the next round, and leave the suites green.
claims: All four findings are addressed. The touches lint now compares elements, the glob matcher reproduces the retired pattern's line-terminator classes, the checkout module sweeps abandoned worktrees at startup with the ones in active use exempt, and the review-order wording now calls for every commit in a pinned range. The verdict is recorded verbatim in the roster. All three suites were re-run and are green, with router at 135 passed, verifier at 94 passed, and registry at 31 passed.
